overall_assessment: The hivolda text-splitting extractor has severe, institution-wide labeling errors. The assessment section is universally captured as mandatory attendance boilerplate rather than the graded exam; the actual graded exam ends up misrouted into reading_list. course_content is missing from most courses. Prerequisites regularly absorb the entire Om emnet paragraph. The reading_list position at end-of-document causes it to capture the flattened Vurderingsform table and administrative stamps in every single course.

findings.evidence: Frammøtekrav: Det er krav til obligatorisk frammøte til dei timeplanfesta aktivitetane.
findings.description: The assessment section captures only the mandatory-attendance sentence from the 'Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen' block. Per the codebook, mandatory attendance is coursework_requirements, not assessment. The actual graded exam (Vurderingsform: Skriftleg eksamen / Munnleg eksamen / Heimeeksamen, with duration, grading scale, and weighting) is never captured here; it ends up misrouted into reading_list.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The text-splitter maps 'Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen' to assessment. The heading fires on the attendance sub-sentence, which is the very first item. The remainder of that block (actual arbeidskrav) then spills into coursework_requirements. The Vurderingsform table is at the very end of the page and is not covered by any heading rule, so it falls through to reading_list.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not map 'Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen' to assessment. Map 'Frammøtekrav' lines to coursework_requirements and 'Arbeidskrav' lines also to coursework_requirements. Add a rule to capture the trailing 'Vurderingsform ...' table as assessment.

findings.evidence:
Emnet inngår i følgande studieprogram
Grunnskulelærarutdanning, trinn 1-7 - master (5 år)
Vurderingsform Gruppering Varighet Karakterskala Andel ... A-F, der A er best og E er siste ståkarakter ...
Godkjent av: 
Arne Myklebust
findings.description: The reading_list section is populated entirely with: (1) a programme-membership line ('Emnet inngår i følgande studieprogram'), (2) the flattened Vurderingsform table containing exam type, grouping, duration, grading scale, and weights — which is graded assessment per the codebook — and (3) an administrative approval stamp ('Godkjent av'). None of this is a reading list. The actual reading list ('Pensumliste for emnet finn du her') is either swallowed into coursework_requirements or nowhere. This means every single hivolda reading_list row contains wrong content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The document ends with programme-membership, Vurderingsform table, and approval stamp. The splitter assigns everything after 'Pensum' or after the last known heading to reading_list. Since these tail elements appear after 'Pensum', they get labeled reading_list rather than being dropped as administrative boilerplate and assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a post-processing rule to drop 'Emnet inngår i følgande studieprogram' and 'Godkjent av' lines from all sections. Map the Vurderingsform table block (starting with 'Vurderingsform Gruppering Varighet') to assessment rather than reading_list. The actual reading list is always a placeholder link ('Pensumliste for emnet finn du her') and should be returned as a single string or marked absent.

findings.description: The coursework_requirements section correctly captures the arbeidskrav items but then absorbs all trailing administrative boilerplate: 'Sensorordning' (grading procedure), 'Evaluering og kvalitetssikring' (quality assurance), 'Maksimumstal' (capacity), 'Emneansvarleg' (course responsible), and the 'Pensum' heading. None of these are coursework requirements per the codebook. The 'Pensum' word ending the section is the heading that triggered reading_list to start.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The section boundary between coursework_requirements and reading_list is placed at the 'Pensum' heading. Everything between the end of arbeidskrav and the 'Pensum' heading has no assigned section rule, so it leaks into coursework_requirements as the open container.
findings.suggested_fix: Add heading rules for 'Sensorordning', 'Evaluering og kvalitetssikring', 'Maksimumstal', and 'Emneansvarleg' to route them to a discard/boilerplate bucket. This will stop them from polluting coursework_requirements.

Emnet krev engasjement og initiativ frå studentane for å fremje eiga og medstudentar si læring. Studiet legg opp til varierte arbeidsformer...
findings.description: The learning_outcomes section absorbs the teaching_methods content that follows under the heading 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar'. This heading describes how the course is taught (lectures, seminars, group work, etc.) — clearly teaching_methods per the codebook — but the splitter either does not recognise this heading or begins the next section too late. As a result teaching_methods is never emitted as a separate section and its content is silently merged into learning_outcomes.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' is either not in the heading map or is mapped to learning_outcomes. The section boundary for learning_outcomes should close at this heading and a new teaching_methods block should open.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' and 'Arbeids- og undervisningsformer' as heading triggers that close learning_outcomes and open teaching_methods. Verify the heading map covers Nynorsk variants of teaching-method headings.

findings.evidence:
Om emnet

Dette emnet er fyrste del av Matematikk 1, den obligatoriske matematikkdelen av grunnskulelærarutdanninga for 1-7. [full paragraph present in ground truth, absent from extractor output]
findings.description: The 'Om emnet' section — the primary course content / subject matter description per the codebook — is not extracted as course_content in the majority of courses. In courses 4–20 and most random courses, no course_content row is present at all in the extractor output. The 'Om emnet' paragraph is either silently dropped or (in course 3) mislabeled as reading_list because a 'Pensum:' header appears before 'Om emnet' in that particular course layout.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading 'Om emnet' is either not in the heading map or is mapped to a section that does not produce a row in sections_raw. When 'Pensum:' metadata appears before 'Om emnet' (course 3 layout), the splitter opens reading_list early and swallows the Om emnet paragraph.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Om emnet' as a heading trigger mapped to course_content. Handle the early-appearing 'Pensum:' metadata header by treating it as a key-value field to discard rather than a section-opening heading.

findings.evidence:
Ingen
Om emnet
Dette emnet er andre del av matematikk 1, den obligatoriske matematikkdelen av grunnskulelærarutdanninga for 1-7. Gjennom emnet får studentane eit didaktisk og fagleg grunnlag...
findings.description: When 'Krav til forkunnskapar' / 'Forkunnskapskrav, emneliste' is followed immediately by 'Om emnet', the prerequisites section absorbs the entire Om emnet course content paragraph (and in some cases the complete course content block). The only genuine prerequisites content is 'Ingen' (none) or a course code list. This is both wrong_content for prerequisites (it contains course content) and causes course_content to be missing.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The splitter opens prerequisites at the forkunnskapskrav heading and does not close it at the 'Om emnet' heading. Since 'Om emnet' is not yet in the heading map (see finding on missing course_content), the prerequisites section stays open until the next recognised heading.
findings.suggested_fix: Register 'Om emnet' as a heading that closes prerequisites and opens course_content. This single fix addresses both this finding and the missing course_content finding.

findings.evidence:
Frammøtekrav: Obligatorisk oppmøte til all timeplanfesta aktivitet...
1. Krav om 80 prosent frammøte/deltaking til obligatorisk undervisning
2. Gjennomføre eit feltarbeid i skulen og presentere resultat frå feltarbeidet for medstudentar
findings.description: In courses where the 'Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen' section contains a numbered list of arbeidskrav (attendance, fieldwork, seminar participation), these are all filed under assessment rather than coursework_requirements. These are mandatory pass/approve gates to sit the exam — not graded components — and must go into coursework_requirements per the codebook. The pattern occurs consistently across the spesialpedagogikk and pedagogikk courses (1, 2, 21, 24) where the arbeidskrav list is longer and more varied than in the matematikk courses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The splitter maps 'Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen' to assessment. When the arbeidskrav items are numbered list items (1, 2, 3) without a separate 'Arbeidskrav:' sub-heading, they all stay in the assessment bucket rather than being re-routed to coursework_requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen' directly to coursework_requirements (not assessment). A sub-rule can optionally split on 'Frammøtekrav' vs. 'Arbeidskrav' sub-headings within that block. Never route this heading to assessment.

har innsikt i matematikkfaget si rolle k
…[truncated 642 chars]
findings.description: The learning_outcomes section is cut off mid-sentence in many courses (showing 'truncated N chars' in the packet). This means the Generell kompetanse bullet points, the teaching_methods paragraph, and whatever else was merged in are all silently dropped. The truncation appears at a fixed character limit applied at display/export time or in the extractor itself, but even the raw text that should be there (e.g. 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' content) is missing from the emitted row. This affects the correctness of the merged content and compounds the merged_sections issue.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: A character cap is being applied to the stored sections_raw text for learning_outcomes. The cap appears to be around 2100–2200 characters for this institution's typical outcome block.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove or raise the character cap on sections_raw text storage. After fixing the merged_sections issue (teaching_methods split), the learning_outcomes section will be shorter and within any reasonable limit.

findings.evidence:
Pensum

Pensumliste for emnet finn du her
findings.description: The actual reading list for every hivolda course is a placeholder: 'Pensumliste for emnet finn du her' (reading list available via link). This minimal content is never captured — instead, the reading_list section is always filled with the Vurderingsform assessment table (see the wrong_content finding). Even when fixed, the true reading list will only be a link/placeholder, which may be returned as a single string or treated as absent.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Pensum' heading triggers reading_list, but the very next thing in the document is the placeholder link followed immediately by 'Emnet inngår i følgande studieprogram' and then the Vurderingsform table. These tail elements override the placeholder in the stored text.
findings.suggested_fix: After fixing the wrong_content issue, strip 'Pensumliste for emnet finn du her' as a known boilerplate placeholder (or return it as-is as a single-string reading list). The Vurderingsform table and programme line should not appear in reading_list at all.

findings.evidence:
Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar
Studiet legg opp til varierte arbeidsformer, mellom anna sjølvstudium, individuell rettleiing, didaktisk refleksjon, utforsking, problemløysing og forelesingar. [content present in ground truth, absent as own section in extractor output]
findings.description: The teaching_methods section is never emitted as a standalone row for hivolda. The 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' heading and content is always absorbed into learning_outcomes (via the merged_sections issue) or silently dropped. This content describes how the course is taught — clearly teaching_methods per the codebook.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' is absent from the heading map. Until that heading is added, teaching_methods will always be missing.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' to the heading map mapped to teaching_methods. This will simultaneously fix the learning_outcomes merged_sections issue.
